premises: Melt-spun FeMnNiGeSi ribbons contain inherent internal stress and defects from rapid solidification
Cyclic compressive loading near the transition temperature redistributes these internal stresses and defects
Redistributed stress/defects lower the nucleation barrier for the magnetostructural transition
Lower nucleation barrier promotes cooperative domain switching, broadening the transition
Broader, more cooperative transition reduces thermal and magnetic hysteresis
